D: Bilbo Baggins is swept off on a quest with thirteen dwarves to reclaim their mountain home.
P: Serve the snacks when the dwarves raid Bilbo's pantry.
S: Cheddar, pork pie and pickle board
Aged cheddar, pork pie, pickled onions, apple and crusty bread
Aged cheddar, pork pie, pickled onions, apples and crusty bread piled onto a big board for everyone to grab.
Green salad with mint and pepitas
Salad leaves, pea shoots, cucumber and mint with a lemon dressing
Baby leaves, pea shoots, cucumber and herbs dressed with lemon and olive oil, scattered with toasted seeds.
Gollum and the riddles in the dark

Flathead pieces dusted in seasoned flour, fried in hot oil until crisp, served with tartare sauce and lemon wedges. Cut 600g flathead fillets into fingers and pat dry. Season 100g plain flour with salt, pepper and a pinch of paprika. Dust the fish in flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs, then coat in 120g panko crumbs. Shallow fry in 1cm of oil at 180C for 2 minutes a side until golden. Mix 150g mayo with 1 tbsp chopped capers, 1 tbsp chopped gherkin, chopped parsley and a squeeze of lemon. Serve the fish with the tartare and lemon wedges.
M: Trolls' garlic and rosemary roast lamb
the three trolls roasting mutton over the fire

Lamb leg rubbed with garlic, rosemary and salt, roasted at 180C for 90 minutes, with roast potatoes and carrots. Cut small slits all over a 2kg lamb leg and push in slivers from 4 garlic cloves and small rosemary sprigs. Rub with olive oil and plenty of salt and pepper. Roast at 180C for 90 minutes for medium, adding 1kg potatoes in chunks and 4 carrots tossed in oil to the tray for the last hour. Rest the lamb 15 minutes under foil. Carve thick and serve with the roast veg, pan juices and mint sauce.
Pork sausages, bacon, mushrooms, tomatoes and fried eggs
Pork sausages, bacon, mushrooms and halved tomatoes fried in one pan, eggs fried in the fat, served with buttered toast.
W: Butter loaf cake with caraway seeds
Butter cake with caraway seeds baked in a loaf tin at 170C for 50 minutes, sliced and served with tea.
K: Warm apple juice and brown ale with honey, cinnamon, cloves and orange peel

Brown ale and cloudy apple juice warmed with honey, cinnamon, cloves and orange peel, ladled into big mugs. Ginger beer version for the hobbits. Pour 750ml cloudy apple juice into a saucepan with 3 tbsp honey, 2 cinnamon sticks, 4 cloves and 3 strips orange peel. Simmer gently for 10 minutes. Turn the heat to low and add 750ml brown ale, warming through for 3 minutes without boiling. Ladle into 4 big mugs and add a cinnamon stick each. For non-drinkers, swap the ale for ginger beer and serve over ice.

dishes.n: Cheddar, pork pie and pickle board

steps.text: Cut the cheddar into wedges and slice the pork pies.
Cut the apples into wedges and tear the bread.
Pile everything onto a big board so guests can raid it at once.

dishes.n: Green salad with mint and pepitas

steps.text: Toast the pepitas in a dry pan.
Slice the cucumber and tear the mint.
Toss the leaves, pea shoots, cucumber and mint, then dress with lemon juice and olive oil.
Scatter with pepitas and pile lightly onto a pale platter.
Fry the sausages until browned.
Add the bacon, mushrooms and tomatoes to the pan.
Fry the eggs in the fat at the end.
Toast the bread and butter it.
Plate it all up.
Beat the butter and sugar until pale, then beat in the eggs.
Fold in the flour, caraway seeds and milk.
Pour into a lined loaf tin.
Bake at 170C.
Cool the cake.
Slice to serve with a cup of tea.
Peel strips of zest from the orange.
Simmer the apple juice with the honey, 2 cinnamon sticks, cloves and zest.
Turn the heat to low and add the ale, warming through without boiling.
Ladle into mugs and add a cinnamon stick to each. For non-drinkers, swap the ale for ginger beer and serve over ice.

s.n: Cheddar, pork pie and pickle board
s.note: Aged cheddar, pork pie, pickled onions, apple and crusty bread
s.how: Pile wedges of aged cheddar, sliced pork pies, a jar of pickled onions, apple wedges and torn crusty bread onto a big board. Set it out so a dozen unexpected guests can raid it at once.

s.n: Green salad with mint and pepitas
s.note: Salad leaves, pea shoots, cucumber and mint with a lemon dressing
s.how: Toss mixed salad leaves with pea shoots, thinly sliced cucumber and torn mint. Dress with lemon juice and olive oil and scatter with toasted pepitas. Pile it lightly onto a pale platter, as elegant as an Elvish table.

m.note: Pork sausages, bacon, mushrooms, tomatoes and fried eggs
m.how: Fry 8 thick pork sausages until browned. Add 8 rashers bacon, 200g sliced mushrooms and halved tomatoes to the pan. Fry 4 eggs in the fat at the end. Serve with buttered toast, because this is the second breakfast of the day.

w.note: Butter loaf cake with caraway seeds
w.how: Beat 175g butter with 175g sugar, then beat in 3 eggs. Fold in 225g self-raising flour, 2 tsp caraway seeds and a splash of milk. Bake in a lined loaf tin at 170C for 50 minutes. Cool and slice to serve with a cup of tea.

d.note: Warm apple juice and brown ale with honey, cinnamon, cloves and orange peel
d.how: Pour 750ml cloudy apple juice into a saucepan with 3 tbsp honey, 2 cinnamon sticks, 4 cloves and 3 strips orange peel. Simmer gently for 10 minutes. Turn the heat to low and add 750ml brown ale, warming through for 3 minutes without boiling. Ladle into 4 big mugs and add a cinnamon stick each. For non-drinkers, swap the ale for ginger beer and serve over ice.
